text.p: Jansher Khan, seeking a record eighth World Open squash title, began his quest with an easy 15-8 15-10 15-6 victory over Craig Wapnick of South Africa on Sunday.

But he now meets the hottest player in the game right now, 22-year-old Canadian Jonathan Power, who followed up two astonishing world tour wins on the way to Karachi by removing England's experienced Danny Meddings 15-8 15-5 17-16 in his first round match.

The most exciting match of the day involved England's number one Del Harris who survived a 91-minute marathon by a single point after losing his way against Australian qualifier Dan Jenson when two games up and 14-7 in the third game.
"I don't know how I could lose a lead like that in any game," Harris said. "My concentration was all over the place. I was thinking about how bad my game was rather than how to win"
